mcqs.question: Who received the Women Empowerment Trailblazers Award presented by the BRICS CCI Women Empowerment Wing?
mcqs.explanation: Kalpana Soren, MLA from Gandey in Jharkhand, received the Women Empowerment Trailblazers Award. Dr. Partha Sarathi Mahanta received the NYSAF 2026 Best Director award, while Sandeep Dighe and Shreya Chatterjee were associated with the Prakash Kardaley Memorial Award.

mcqs.question: Which journalist and former editor served as India’s Ambassador to Denmark from 2001 to 2003?
mcqs.explanation: H.K. Dua served as India’s Ambassador to Denmark from 2001 to 2003 and was also associated with the editorship of Hindustan Times, The Indian Express and The Tribune. K.N. Panikkar was a historian, while K.G. George was associated with the Corps of Signals.

mcqs.question: Who authored the book “Karuna: The Power of Compassion”?
mcqs.explanation: “Karuna: The Power of Compassion” was authored by Kailash Satyarthi. Dr. Dheeraj Kakadia authored “Mahatma: A Great Communicator”, Han Kang wrote “We Do Not Part”, and Karen Hao wrote “Empire of AI”.
